GIOLINA FILMS

Experience

Reviews from our clients, the process, frequently asked questions, and what exactly makes a GioLina films couple.

HOW IT WORKS

OUR PROCESS

Frank was great to work with. The red carpet was a hit at our corporate event. He was very fun and professional. We would highly recommend him and his services for any event.

Ready to Go productions were so great to work with! Frank is amazing at what he does. Professionalism and communication throughout the whole process was A++! Ready to Go offers a unique personal touch to the whole wedding video process- I couldn’t have asked for better! Our love story interview/same day edit video turned out amazing- we loved every minute of the whole process from filming to being surprised with the video at our wedding. We are so, so pleased! Can’t wait to see our final video!

Lauren

"We couldn’t be more grateful for the amazing work of Giolina Films."

We had such a great experience with Ready to Go Productions! Frank & his team did an amazing job. They were able to capture our special day so magically. The team is very professional and reliable! They go over every detail with you. I would definitely recommend Ready to Go to anyone! 🙂

Jennifer B.

"Above and beyond what I could’ve ever imagined ! Totally worth it !."

Quality above and beyond what I could’ve ever imagined; GioLina Film’s ability to capture the raw genuine expressions of joy and love that surrounded my wedding day is something I’m truly grateful for. The GioLina team was professional, down-to-earth, and very comfortable to work with. I thought it couldn’t get any better after I saw my photographs but I was seriously blown away when I saw the short film they created of the day! The creativity and quality is so professional down to the tiniest details, and every one who watches it is always so impressed. It brings me straight back to that day and without fail ALWAYS makes me cry happy tears. I’m so glad I trusted them with my special day. Needless to say, I highly recommend GioLina Films !!

Deanna B

"Professional, beautiful videos!!!!"

We highly recommend GioLina Films and Frank for your wedding! Frank put us at ease from start to finish. From the moment of our consultation to the end product, he was great to work with. It was nice to have one less thing to worry about when it came to wedding vendors. He took our ideas and suggestions and made sure to capture our day in the way we could’ve only dreamed. Plus his prices are very competitive! We will definitely be recommending GioLina to all our friends.

Mina

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

WHAT ARE YOUR MINIMUMS & WHAT DOES THE AVERAGE CLIENT SPEND?

All prices are custom, feel free to inquire to learn more!

ARE THERE ANY SURPRISE FEES I SHOULD BE AWARE OF?

All fees (travel, shipping, etc.) are built into your custom proposal price. The only time this price will change is if additional services or products are added on after the initial booking.

HOW DO WE SCHEDULE A CONSULTATION?

If you’d like to meet over Zoom and talk details, just let us know and we’ll send you a Calendly link to schedule time right on our calendar.
